verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair capability to ask of a cloud robotics platform like Viam, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that external AI agents can drive Viam through its CLI and SDKs (viam-docs-12, viam-docs-59), plus an llms.txt file. Those are developer building blocks for outside agents, not an assistant inside the product that users can delegate tasks to.
